definition: Whether the same frozen definition can be computed independently in both cohorts
acceptable_output: A two-column availability and QC table with identical metric definitions
prohibited_inference: That equal availability makes clinical contrasts exchangeable

definition: Compare the sign of prespecified within-cohort group contrasts when each contrast has an unambiguous direction
acceptable_output: Side-by-side standardized effects and confidence intervals labelled with each cohort's actual contrast
prohibited_inference: Replication of a disease signature or a common causal direction

definition: Compare diagnosis PERMANOVA R2 in the anchor with resistance-status PERMANOVA R2 in the external cohort
acceptable_output: Side-by-side R2, pseudo-F, uncertainty/permutation P, group count and feature-space annotation
prohibited_inference: A pooled R2, formal meta-analytic coefficient or claim that magnitudes estimate one effect

definition: Compare whether each cohort's PERMANOVA is or is not materially dispersion-qualified
acceptable_output: Paired PERMANOVA/PERMDISP dashboard for each cohort
prohibited_inference: That similar dispersion proves similar biology

definition: Intersect taxids meeting prespecified prevalence thresholds calculated separately within each cohort
acceptable_output: Jaccard/intersection/union summaries at 5%, 10% and 20%; primary 10% counts include 166 species and 45 genera
prohibited_inference: That shared detection means equal abundance, pathogenicity or clinical association

definition: For taxids prevalent in both cohorts, show each cohort's contrast-specific prevalence effect
acceptable_output: Contrast-labelled effect estimates with multiplicity control; no combined coefficient
prohibited_inference: Replicated taxon association, because four-diagnosis and resistance effects differ

definition: Correlate or count signs of contrast-specific taxon effects across shared taxa
acceptable_output: Sensitivity-only rank/sign summary with a null generated independently of outcome selection
prohibited_inference: Biological replication or validation of a disease signature

definition: Display classified-fraction distributions and medians by cohort
prohibited_inference: An inferential cohort effect or absolute bacterial burden

definition: Fit one sample-level diagnosis/community model after concatenating cohorts
prohibited_inference: A common diagnosis effect, multicenter model or batch-adjusted biological estimate

synthesis_candidate: Formal meta-analysis of current clinical coefficients
definition: Combine four-level diagnosis and binary resistance coefficients
prohibited_inference: Any summary effect or heterogeneity statistic presented as one clinical estimand

definition: Call PRJCA046985 an independent replication of the PRJNA1056765 diagnosis result
prohibited_inference: Replication, validation or independent confirmation of the anchor disease signature
